tldr: Afternoon batch, Aug 22: The agent-protocol layer consolidated — Google's A2A joined the Agentic AI Foundation alongside Anthropic's MCP, putting inter-agent and agent-to-tool standards under one neutral roof (250+ members, no vendor side to pick). dots studio open-sourced dots3-note, a 280B/16B multimodal MoE with 512K context under Apache 2.0. Anthropic, after months of enterprise pushback, will move Mythos/Fable customer data into customers' own clouds this fall — retention easing without giving up monitoring. Qwen3.8-27B kept stacking wins: #1 open-weight on Harvey's Legal Agent benchmark, #1 local model on Cline within 4 days, plus fresh NVFP4+DFlash2 SGLang recipes. Nous pushed Hermes Agent's 'use it however you want' manifesto with a few-dollars-a-month cloud VPS, and Kimi targeted financial analysts with a Kimi Work dashboard-building tutorial.

articles.title: Google's A2A Joins AAIF — Agent Protocols Consolidate Under One Roof
articles.summary: A2A is now a hosted Agentic AI Foundation project alongside Anthropic's MCP — no merge, two layers of the stack, one neutral governance home, 250+ members.

articles.title: dots3-note Preview: Open Multimodal MoE, 280B/16B, 512K Context

articles.title: Anthropic Eases 30-Day Data-Retention Rule for Enterprises
articles.summary: After months of pushback, Mythos/Fable customer data moves to the customer's cloud this fall — monitoring stays, storage moves; Anthropic retains none.

articles.summary: Qwen3.8-27B ranks #1 open-weight on Harvey's Legal Agent benchmark — strong enough for professional tasks, small enough to run locally.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-27B Becomes #1 Local Model in Cline Within 4 Days
articles.summary: Builders pushed Qwen3.8-27B to the top of Cline's local-model rankings just four days after release.
